original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: A tall split-diamond prism stands on an ivory tripod between two angled mirror shutters, grounding stakes, and a rack of spare lens plates.
A stepped ivory guardhouse carries one oversized round prism window beside crossed shard pikes, a training target, and a crenellated roof.
A broad hide war drum hangs between crooked reedwood stilts above ditch stakes, a forked pennant mast, and a peat lantern.
A cracked ship bell hangs beneath black wreck ribs above blank slate ledgers, six salvage baskets, a hooked crane, and a torn mirror sail.
An oversized balance scale rises above a toothed ore crusher, stepped sample drawers, assay cups, and a narrow glowing furnace cupola.
A crescent reed barge rests against a crooked pier beneath a tall square lantern, crossed ferry poles, bundled reeds, and a small canvas awning.
Three oversized mushroom caps shelter a round turf croft with a stout door, fenced fungus bed, spore lanterns, and one shield-like leaning cap.
A patched canvas lean-to crowds a scrapwood bench, bent rabbit-ear vane, crossed blades, bundled bow, metal plates, and a broad spoked cart wheel.
A black-brick dome kiln glows through its arched mouth below a crooked chimney, with a heavy mallet, sealed cinder pots, and an iron rack.
A steep snow-capped stone bothy stands beside a forked crystal beacon, crossed long pikes, a marker post, and a blanket-framed doorway.
A circular thorn arch encloses a tiny thatched watch hut beneath a hooked polearm, with a short bow rack, carved trail stones, and a pennant.
A crescent skiff rests on timber cradles beside a tilted pennant mast, hanging lantern-net, shell-float baskets, rope winch, and curved drying rack.
A narrow three-level stone hostel rises along a zigzag exterior stair beside a covered hitch, trail horn, paired cairns, and a single window.
A striped raised awning shelters two geometric evaporation trays, a forked rake, stacked salt bricks, woven crystal baskets, and a sun disk.
Three asymmetric crystal spires rise behind a stone-lined well, timber lifting frame, suspended faceted bucket, crystal lantern, and low tool chest.
A broad snow-capped log lodge bears an oversized crescent ice hook above crossed snowshoes, a fur drying beam, trap stakes, and a glass lantern.
Three jagged black-glass blades arch around a riveted shelter, suspended forge bowl, broad cutting pick, stacked mirror slabs, and hauling sled.
A sturdy stone-and-timber toll lodge stands beside a covered gate beam, crossed pikehooks, curved bow rack, hanging road lantern, and boundary stones.
A long reed-thatch kennel presents three arched hound bays beneath a carved running-hound post, mossglass shield panels, trough, and handler staff.
Two split-stone spires support a timber nesting platform with an empty angular perch, diamond sling target, hanging feed baskets, and steep ladder.
A fruit-laden bough arches over a half-timber storehouse, upright halberd racks, round millstone sling wheel, harvest baskets, and levy bell.
A tall tripod mast holds a split-tail diamond kite above a low ridge shelter, circular flare basket, hooked runner poles, and rolled kite cloth.
Two bent living trees form a green arch over a hollow-stump doorway with bundled cudgels, hanging sap whistles, resin bowls, and woven fence.
A narrow shingle pilot house rises on short piles beside a striped signal mast, crossed polearms, hanging anchor, rope drum, and round beacon window.
A rounded root-and-stone mound has three tunnel mouths, five stepping lantern niches, a crown of glimmercaps, a needle-dart rack, and hand winch.
A stilted reed croft wraps around an oversized bronze bog bell with broad peat mauls, sealed flare jars, crooked stair, and marsh-lantern post.
A squat stone armory surrounds a tall blank faceted milestone beside a circular buckler rack, folded cartbow, bolt crates, and roof pennant.
A snow-capped timber wharf house stands on ice-braced piles beneath a crescent cutter blade, paired lantern-skates, net drum, and mooring post.
A broad turf-covered charcoal clamp has three short vents beside a rough lean-to, crossed mauls, stacked ember packs, log rack, and shielded glow.
Two black-basalt towers join above a deep angular arch and raised portcullis, with glowing marker stones, heavy bolter rack, and chain winch.
